segments.ja256:1.3: Ajjhagamuṃ ayasaṃ lohaṃ [ajjhagaṃsu ayolohaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], tipusīsañca vāṇijā;
segments.ja256:2.1: Te ca tena asantuṭṭhā, bhiyyo bhiyyo akhāṇisuṃ;
segments.ja256:2.3: Te tatthāsīviso [tattha āsīviso (ka.), tatthapāsīviso (syā.)] ghoro, tejassī tejasā hani.
segments.ja256:3.1: Tasmā khaṇe nātikhaṇe, atikhātaṃ [atikhaṇaṃ (ka.)] hi pāpakaṃ;
segments.ja256:3.3: Khātena ca [khaṇena ca (ka.), khaṇanena (syā.)] dhanaṃ laddhaṃ, atikhātena [atikhaṇena (ka.)] nāsitanti.

lines: Te ca tena asantuṭṭhāti te ca vāṇijā tena dhanena asantuṭṭhā.
Atikhātena nāsitanti atikhaṇena tañca dhanaṃ jīvitañca nāsitaṃ.
